name: Anastasis Giakoumatos
tagline: Building Android apps used by millions, in banking, payments and iGaming
intro: Mobile Engineer specializing in Android, based in Athens, Greece. For the past 7 years I've built apps where reliability matters most: mobile banking, payments and iGaming, used by millions of people. I care about codebases that scale with the team, so I lead modularization efforts, mentor developers and keep quality high through testing and code reviews. I work in Kotlin and Jetpack Compose every day, and use AI tools where they genuinely speed things up, without lowering the bar.
